_reliability_thresholds_comment: LLM % thresholds for reliability badge colors. Green (High): LLM <= green_max_llm. Yellow (Good): LLM between green_max_llm and red_min_llm. Red (Poor): LLM >= red_min_llm.

inline_claim_highlights._style_comment: Green = metadata (structured data), Yellow = database (RAG documents), Blue = web search (external), Red = LLM interpretation

_reliability_display_comment: Options: visual (color badges only), text_style (hedging language only), both (badges + hedging), none (disabled)
